title: IVG  Unicorn Hoops Nic Salt E-Liquid 20mg
description: IVG Unicorn Hoops is tantalising blend of plump marshmallows and wholesome, comforting cereal finished off with a splash of milk for a delicious breakfast vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
